text:
anya: Quick heads-upbringing up new q6b-int3 variant for franklin-labs. Want a focused curation sweep to protect our golden set and catch subtle formatting/code regressions.
riley: SGTM. Which golden slices to prioritize? code examples, multi-paragraph summaries, and customer templates?
anya: Yes to all three. Also any prompts that are part of our current golden-anchors list (golden-anchors-2026).
josh: I can run a dedupe+audit pass: exact-token ban, then fuzzy cluster at 92% to group near-duplicates. We should output a small "near_dup_audit.csv" for humans.
tessa: For labeling, propose a micro-golden campaign named mgold-q6b-smoke. Purpose: mark regression severity only and decide if samples should be promoted/demoted in the golden set.
labeler-ops-bot: @tessa created campaign mgold-q6b-smoke (1200 tasks) -> reviewers: "golden-smoke"; tags_required=[severity,regression_type,promote_demote_note]; ETA=36h.
riley: Include metadata per-sample: sample_id, prompt_hash, intent, length_bucket, model_variant, quant_profile, decode, baseline_model, golden_anchor_flag.
josh: CSV header I'll export:
```
sample_id,prompt_hash,intent,length_bucket,model_variant,quant_profile,decode,seed,baseline_model,golden_anchor_flag
```
anya: Add auto-prefilter rules: flag if token_overlap < 0.7 OR structural_delta > 0.2 (where structural_delta measures changes in code blocks or list formatting).
tessa: Label instructions: severity [none/minor/major/critical], regression_type [hallucination,formatting,omission,code-bug,other], promote_demote_note [promote/demote/hold]. If promote, include reason.
labeler-ops-bot: Campaign mgold-q6b-smoke updated: priority=high; reviewers=senior(4)/rotating(6); auto-tags=[prefilter,structural_flag].
riley: Also include our small adversarial code set (code-adversarial-50) and 100 canonical golden anchors so we can see if any anchor flips.
josh: Uploaded initial_batch.csv to s3://redwood-qa/mgold-q6b/initial_batch.csv (total unique_prompts=650). Dual-run: franklin-fp16 (baseline) and q6b-int3-default. Two rows per prompt.
anya: Good. For code prompts run a static lint + heuristic exec-risk check and auto-tag any suspicious constructs (eval, subprocess, write-to-/etc). These should be prioritized for senior review.
tessa: For the first 200 edgecases, allocate senior labelers only. We'll also lock the golden promotion pipeline: only ops lead can accept promote/demote changes.
riley: Add a tiny harness that computes BLEU and normalized token overlap and writes per-intent summaries: flagged_count, avg_bleu_delta, max_structural_delta.
josh: Will snapshot candidate vs baseline outputs to s3://redwood-qa/mgold-q6b/flags/{sample_id}.json for any flagged sample. Also include prompt context and model params.
anya: Decision rules: if any critical regression on a golden_anchor -> immediate rollback of q6b in canary; if >4% of golden samples are demoted -> pause and triage. Otherwise continue phased rollout.
tessa: I'll post rollcall when labels start to land. Keep updates in-thread only.
